getProductInfo.productDescription:
Store introduction

A healing cafe where you can interact closely with capybaras.

Spend peaceful moments taking photos and feeding with the laid-back capybaras.

We offer a 30-minute trial lesson, which can be extended to 1 hour if needed.

This space also serves as a café, allowing you to enjoy drinks while immersing yourself in the therapeutic atmosphere of being close to capybaras.

The store has English-speaking staff, so international guests can visit with peace of mind.

Just a 5-minute walk from Harajuku Station.

It has one of the largest capybara populations in Japan.

The same shop also has a Samoyed cafe, so you can visit both if you're interested.


Product description

30-minute Capybara Interaction Experience

A healing cafe where you can get up close with capybaras

Take photos and feed the leisurely and cute capybaras, and enjoy a peaceful time.

The branch was renovated and completed at the end of October.


Package details:

· Interact with capybaras

- Free drinks


<Branch name>

Capybara Hot Spring Moffu Tokyo

Store address

Om169 Building, 1-6-9 Jingumae, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo

How to get there

5-minute walk from JR Harajuku Station (Takeshita Street Exit)
